svg.title: The squeeze theorem: x times sine of 1 over x
svg.desc: The graph of f(x) = x sin(1/x) for x between −0.4 and 0.4, x not 0, drawn in crimson. It wiggles faster and faster near 0 but stays between the blue lines y = |x| and y = −|x|. Both blue graphs reach 0 at x = 0, so f is squeezed to 0: the limit of f(x) as x approaches 0 is 0. An open circle at the origin marks that f(0) is not defined.
svg.text: Squeezed between −|x| and |x|, the limit at 0 is 0
